title: AI Native Java Developer Hiring Hackathon
description:
**Become An AI Native Engineer\- Build real systems with AI. Compete with Top Developers. Get Hired** 




 We are launching a high\-intensity hiring challenge to identify the next generation of AI Native Java Developers — engineers who don’t just write code, but know how to collaborate with AI to build production\-grade systems faster and smarter.
 



 If you use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Windsurf, or other AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow, this hiring drive is designed for you.
 



 Build with AI. Code with Speed. Get Hired.
 



  





**“A modern engineering hiring experience designed for AI\-native developers.”** 




  





**What we are looking for?** 




 We are hiring developers who can:
 


* Build scalable backend systems using Java
* Use AI coding assistants effectively
* Review, debug, and improve AI\-generated code
* Think architecturally, not just syntactically
* Move fast while maintaining engineering quality
* Work like modern AI\-first software engineers



 This is not a traditional coding test. This is a real\-world AI engineering challenge.
 



**Hiring Process:** 




**Stage 1 \- HR \+ Technical Screening Interview** 




 Shortlisted candidates will attend an initial screening discussion.
 



 This includes:
 


* Candidate background discussion
* AI coding workflow discussion
* Live code review exercise
* GitHub profile review
* Communication and problem\-solving evaluation



 We are specifically evaluating:
 


* How you think
* How you review code
* How you use AI tools effectively



**Stage 2 \- AI Native Hackathon** 




  





**The Challenge** 




 Top 20 candidates will be invited for an in\-person hackathon where they will build a working software system within 5 hours.
 *(Details will be emailed to the shorlisted candidates)* 




**Important:** 




 Candidates must bring:
 


* Their own laptop
* Their preferred development setup
* Active AI coding assistant tools (Cursor, Copilot, etc.)



 We intentionally want candidates working in their own environment because modern engineering productivity depends on developer tooling mastery.
 



  





**What We Will Evaluate** 




 This is NOT just about writing code manually.
 



 We want to observe:
 


* How you collaborate with AI
* Prompt engineering for development
* Speed of implementation
* Architecture decisions
* Debugging capability
* AI\-generated code validation
* Engineering judgment
* Git discipline
* Product thinking



**Submission Process** 




 At the end of the hackathon:
 


* Candidates will upload their code to GitHub
* Share a public repository link
* Submit implementation notes and approach



 Our engineering and AI review systems will evaluate:
 


* Code quality
* AI usage patterns
* System design
* Maintainability
* Production readiness



**Final Technical Discussion** 




 Top candidates will then participate in a final engineering interaction focused on:
 


* Architecture choices
* AI\-assisted development approach
* Tradeoffs and scalability
* Debugging walkthrough
* Ownership mindset



**Why This Hiring Model Is Different** 




 Traditional hiring tests memory. We want to test modern engineering capability.
 



 The best engineers today:
 


* Use AI effectively
* Move rapidly
* Validate intelligently
* Build efficiently
* Think critically



 This hiring challenge is designed to identify exactly those engineers.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Rippling is looking for an experienced Technical Recruiter to join our fast\-paced, agile recruiting team. In this role, you will own the recruiting process end to end for Senior Eng Managers, Staff, and Senior SWE IC roles in our engineering teams.
   

  

****What You'll Do:****
* Manage full\-cycle recruiting process ensuring a positive and seamless candidate experience
* Be responsible for sourcing and developing a candidate pipeline through creative and efficient sourcing strategies
* Brainstorm with hiring managers to assemble powerful sourcing strategies for each search
* Calibrate candidates, update them throughout the process (deliver exceptional candidate experience), and put serious rigor to pre\-close \+ negotiate compensation
* Set hiring managers' expectations on the interview process we have in place and ensure that alignment is there as it impacts conversion efficiency
* Partner with engineering and recruiting leadership to remove closing barriers by deeply understanding what is in the way of being successful/getting the OAs

****Qualifications:****
* At least 8 years of SWE hiring experience
* At least 2 years hiring Staff\+ and Director of Eng profiles
* At least 3 years experience with global candidate markets and working with stakeholders in global geos
* At least 5 years of sourcing and building your own pipeline
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity
* Experience in a fast\-paced, hyper\-growth environment
* Strong attention to detail
* Experience with ATS systems

* Perform other miscellaneous duties as required by management.

 Master's Degree

* Experience in building rapport and collaborating with Hiring Managers through the open requisition, sourcing, debriefing and offer stages.
* Expertise in sourcing through social media channels and other innovative sourcing channels.
* Demonstrable experience in partner management and strength to hold difficult conversations with them.
* Build expertise in deep domain knowledge and understanding of business strategy and drive innovation.

* Experience in direct sourcing and recruitment experience in a corporate or consultancy (RPO set\-up is preferred).

* Demonstrated interpersonal skills while contributing to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.
* Maintain technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing publications.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Description** 




  





**The role** 




  





 You will own our most senior internal searches end to end, from first conversation with the candidate through to offer. The people you'll be hiring are directors and C\-level, so you are the first impression this company makes on them. You'll run intake directly with our founders and department heads, which includes telling them when the brief they've given you will not produce the hire they want.
 



  





 This is not a coordination role. It is not suited to someone who needs the search strategy decided before they start.
 



  





**Who We Are** 




  





 AI Acquisition is a multi\-8\-figure business helping founders and operators scale with AI. T vchousands of clients, hundreds of mastermind participants, with the US as our primary market. We're bootstrapped with no outside capital, so we set our own timelines and hire people who can operate without a script.
 



  





 Our Talent function was built from zero in the last fifteen months: ATS, AI screening gates, tiered assessment frameworks, and a hiring bar the founders now use. A delivery team handles high\-volume pipeline operations. You'll take whatever needs judgement, at any level, and you'll pick up the rest when the load demands it.
 



  





**Requirements** 




  





**Engagement and hours** 




  





 This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. You invoice monthly and handle your own tax and statutory obligations in your country of residence.
 



 Expect a 50 to 60 hour week. Our team spans the UAE, the UK and the US, and this role holds the middle of that span. Your day starts on UAE business hours and runs into the US East Coast morning, with senior candidate calls landing outside conventional hours.
 



 We say this plainly because the people who do well here choose it. If you need fixed hours, this is not the right role and we would rather you know before you apply.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




  




* The full range of searches, end to end, several at once. A C\-level hire and a junior specialist role in the same week, and both get done properly
* Pipeline building ahead of the requisition. Talent mapped, warmed and ready before the role opens, not scrambled when it does
* Candidate engagement over months, not days. Keeping strong people warm when there is nothing live for them, and giving them a reason to take your call the next time
* Employer brand in practice. Being able to answer "why would I leave what I have for AIA" with something specific and true, and building the narrative that makes senior people want the conversation
* Strategic advisory to hiring managers. Market reality, realistic timelines, what the role needs to pay, and when the brief they've written will not produce the hire they want
* Intake and calibration with founders and department heads, including the disagreement
* First contact with director and C\-level candidates, and being the reason they stay in process instead of going quiet
* Direct sourcing where no pipeline exists and inbound is useless
* Written candidate evaluations a founder can decide on without a follow\-up call
* Quality oversight on shortlists coming through the delivery team Testing what works. Running A/B on titles, post copy and channels, and making the call on what to keep based on quality of applicant rather than volume
* Assessment design and execution. Building and running structured evaluations, scorecards and one\-way assessments against a defined hiring bar, not judging on gut



  





**What You Need** 




  




* 6\+ years in talent acquisition, at least 3 of them in\-house, embedded or RPO. Agency\-only will not clear the bar
* Senior or leadership search experience. Volume\-only backgrounds are not a fit for this seat
* Demonstrable hiring into the US or UK market, representing an employer to candidates in that market
* Near\-native spoken and written English. You will improvise on camera with senior people, not read from notes
* Evidence of managing senior stakeholders, including disagreeing with them productively
* Direct sourcing that works, with response rates you can point to
* Comfortable operating as an independent contractor, invoicing monthly and managing your own tax position
* Real schedule flexibility across UAE, UK and US East Coast hours. Calls outside standard business hours are routine, not occasional
* Evidence of building talent pipelines ahead of demand, not only filling open roles reactively
* You have kept candidates engaged over months and converted them later. You can name one
* You can articulate an employer value proposition and adapt it by audience, rather than repeating the careers page
* Experience designing or running structured candidate assessments. Scorecards, structured interviews, work samples, psychometric or cognitive tools
* You have tested and iterated on your own job posts and can tell us what changed and what it produced
* An active, credible LinkedIn presence. You post, you engage, and people in your market know who you are. Passive profiles will not clear this bar



  





**What Stands Out** 




  




* Multi\-country or multi\-entity hiring
* You've built process, not only run someone else's
* You've been the only recruiter in the room and it was fine
* You've overseen or coached junior recruiters
* You've run A/B tests on titles, posts or channels and have the data to show for it
* AI\-assisted sourcing and outreach stack. Clay, HeyReach, n8n, Exa, or equivalent. Name what you've built with it, not what you've heard of
* You've built a talent pipeline that produced a hire months after the first conversation
* You've worked somewhere with no employer brand and had to create the reason people said yes



  





**Benefits** 




  





**What you get** 




  





**Up to $80K/Annually** 
 , as an independent contractor, based on experience
 



  





**Direct access to founders.** 
 You will sit in calibration with the people who make the decisions. No layers between you and the call
 



  





**A real AI stack, used daily.** 
 Clay, HeyReach, n8n, Exa, LLM screening built into the workflow. You will use agents as part of the job, not as a side experiment, and you will have room to build your own
 



  





**A seat that rewards building.** 
 The function was built from zero in fifteen months. What you build here stays and gets used. If you want to inherit a finished process and maintain it, this is the wrong seat. If you want to put your own frameworks into a company that will actually run them, this is a rare one
 



  





**How We Hire** 




 Application, one\-way video, short written exercise, structured interview with our Global Head of People \& Talent, working session with a founder. You'll know where you stand at every stage.

About Lokal :
   

  

 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using the

 every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually,
   

  

 something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in
   

  

 one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave
   

  

 us the insight \- when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how
   

  

 Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

 Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:

 As a Non\-Tech Recruiter at Neo, you'll own full\-cycle hiring across Product, Marketing, and Support the functions that turn a great product into a great company. You'll treat AI the way a great recruiter treats a strong referral network: as leverage. You'll run sourcing, drafting, ranking, and coordination through AI so your human hours go where they actually matter — reading people, selling the mission, and making judgment calls a model can't. If you still copy\-paste the same outreach fifty times by hand, this role will feel like a downgrade. If that sentence made you wince, we should talk.
 



 You'll partner closely with function leaders and hiring managers, keep candidates genuinely well\-treated end to end, close offers that stick, and help build the AI\-native recruiting motion itself — the prompts, the playbooks, and the shared skills that make the whole Talent team faster.

* Range across role profiles. Switch between a product manager, a performance marketer, and a support lead without losing rigor — each function has its own signal.

title: Talent Acquisition & Founder's Office
description:
Okay Done is a digital marketing agency with a diverse clientele, such as Royal Challengers Bengaluru, OnePlus, VRL, Google, Bengaluru City Police, Heineken, and Health Care Global to name a few. We work across various industries, including sports, consumer, hospitality, luxury, F\&B, real estate and D2C.
 



  





**Overview** 




 Location:
 **Bengaluru** 
  \| Type:
 **Full\-time, onsite** 
 \| Experience:
 **1 to 2 years** 




  





**Read This First** 




 If things slip through your fingers, this role is not for you.
 



  





 That is the single hardest filter we have, and we are not going to be shy about it. In one day you will move between a candidate you are chasing, a letter that has to go out, a calendar that keeps changing, and a vendor waiting on an answer. Four different jobs before lunch.
 



  





 Most people can do any one of those well. Very few can do all four in the same day without dropping one. The ones who drop one usually do not notice they dropped it, which is the actual problem.
 



  





 If you are the person who remembers the thing everyone else forgot, keep reading.
 



  





**The Role, Honestly** 




 Three jobs in one, and all three are apprenticeships.
 



  





**Talent acquisition:** 
 You find people. Then you learn how we pick them, because how we hire is genuinely different from how most agencies do it, and it is the reason the work here is good. You will be taught this directly by the Partner and the Managing Partner. Not from a course, not from a recruitment SOP. From sitting in on the calls and then being handed the next one.
 



  





**Founder's office:** 
 You sit beside the people running this company. The calendar, the follow ups, the things that need chasing, the decisions that need turning into action. You will see how the business is actually run, from the seat where it happens.
 



  





**HR:** 
 The paperwork, the sheets, the attendance, the onboarding. Unglamorous, and the reason everything else works.
 



  





 Do all three well and you will understand how a company is staffed and run within a year. Most people take five.
 



  





**What You Will Actually Do** 




 • Scout talent. Hunt across LinkedIn, portfolios, Instagram, campuses, referrals, and places nobody else is looking. Build pipelines before we need them, not after. A good scout has three names ready the day a role opens.
 



 • Learn our way of hiring. Sit in on screening calls with the Partner and the Managing Partner. Watch what they ask and understand why. Then start running first rounds yourself.
 



 • Run the hiring process end to end. Job posts, applications, shortlists, scheduling, feedback, closing the loop with everyone. Candidates should never be left wondering where they stand.
 



 • Run the Managing Partner's calendar. Guard it, sequence it, protect it. Know what deserves an hour and what deserves fifteen minutes. Confirm, remind, reschedule, and never let a meeting fall through because nobody chased it.
 



 • Own the paperwork. Offer letters, appointment letters, onboarding documents, exit formalities. Accurate, on time, no typos in someone's name or their number.
 



 • Keep the sheets clean. Attendance, leave, candidate trackers, employee records. If a sheet is out of date, that is on you and only you.
 



 • Onboard people properly. First day sorted, laptop sorted, accounts sorted, introductions made. Nobody's first impression of this place should be confusion.
 



 • A bit of internal ops. Not content ops, we already have someone excellent on that. This is the managerial side. Vendor coordination, office and admin running, internal approvals, keeping small processes from becoming big problems. It is a slice of the job, not the job.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




 • You are frighteningly organized. Chaos walks in, order walks out.
 



 • You read people quickly. You will be the first human every candidate speaks to. Within one call you should have a real opinion on whether they are worth the founders' time.
 



 • You speak and write well. How you sound is how this company looks to everyone applying to it.
 



 • You are not a pushover. You will have to tell a senior person their meeting is moving, or that their document is late. You do it politely, firmly, every time.
 



 • You notice details. Wrong date on a letter, a name spelled two ways, a mismatch between two sheets. You catch it before anyone else does.
 



 • You close loops. You do not leave a message unanswered or a task half done because nobody followed up. You are the follow up.
 



 • You are hungry, coachable, and allergic to mediocrity.
 



  





**About Experience** 




 We are looking for 1 to 2 years of work experience. Not zero, because you should already know what a workplace feels like and how to talk to people senior to you. Not ten, because this is a role you grow into and we would rather build the habits with you than undo someone else's.
 



  





 What that experience was in matters far less. HR, recruitment, sales, operations, hospitality, teaching, a family business, something else entirely. We will teach you recruitment, documentation, and how this company runs. What we cannot teach is how you carry yourself, whether you notice things, and how badly you want it.
 



  





**What You Get** 




 • Direct mentorship from the Partner and the Managing Partner. You learn hiring, judgement, and operations from the people doing it, not teaching it.
 



 • A seat where you see everything. Strategy, hiring, decisions. Most people at your stage see none of it.
 



 • Real ownership from month one. Your own roles to fill, your own systems to build. No fetching coffee.
 



 • Weekends that are actually yours. Weekdays are intense and we will not pretend otherwise. When Friday ends, you shut off completely. No calls, no messages, no guilt.
 



 • A career accelerator. People who do this role well become HR leads, chiefs of staff, and operators. Not assistants.

 Knowledge of Labor Laws \& Statutory Acts

 Documentation \& Reporting
 



 Systems \& Tools Knowledge
